exposure: Preterm vs. full-term infant (mother's milk type)
cohort: The study participants were healthy mothers of preterm (28-32 weeks) and full-term (>37 weeks) infants from Switzerland.
finding: When compared at an equivalent postmenstrual age, preterm human milk contained significantly less zinc and copper from week 39 to 48 and less selenium from week 39 to 44 than term human milk.
